domain: Every characteristic-zero field, positive odd integera, and regular p=t^a(C(x)+t^2D(x))/x on t^2+2xy=1. Unit-center rationality, arbitrary-degree zero-center purity, the a3 degree<=5 box, and a scoped infinity restriction are separate claims. Not arbitrary height-five phases or arbitrary quintics.

claims.label: OddStartRationalCenter
claims.scope: Every all-pure unit-center phase in this form has u=xX^a/C, X=sqrt(-D/C), and A=C/X^a in K(x). The proof extends endpoint contact to every odda and applies the retained general quadratic inverse-branch character lemma. Rationality is necessary, not sufficient for purity.

claims.label: OddStartZeroCenterPurity
claims.scope: For C(0)=D(0)=0, in ALL degrees, purity iff the second and fourth angular moments vanish iff x^2 divides BOTH C andD. Every such phase is safe for every fixed sphere and original polynomial marker.

claims.label: OddStartThreeDegreeFiveSafety
claims.scope: Every pure p=t^3(C+t^2D)/x of least degree<=5 is safe. Up to nonzero scalar, its unit-center normal form is2t^3y; its zero-center forms are x t^3(alpha+beta*x), including zero.

claims.label: OddStartFiniteNonzeroInfinity
claims.scope: For a pure unit-center phase with u finite nonzero at infinity, rational X has integer growthr>=1 and exact least degree(a+2)(r+1), composite. Equivalently in this class a pure phase of prime least degree must have u vanishing or a pole at infinity. This is the contrapositive with every nonzero unit-center degree>=2, not a sufficiency statement for either infinity behavior.
